versions.changelog: First stable release, replacing 0.19.0. Requires Jellyfin 12.2 or newer. Third-party notices ship in each release archive with exact versions and licence texts, and release files carry build provenance attestations, checked with gh attestation verify.

Requires Jellyfin 12.2 or newer; servers on 12.0 and 12.1 keep 0.18.2 (#60). Third-party notices now ship in each release archive with exact versions and licence texts, and the Help tab lists library versions again (#61). Release files carry build provenance attestations, checked with gh attestation verify (#60).

name: HwProbe
description: Runs short test transcodes for each hardware acceleration backend and setting on the Transcoding and Trickplay pages. Shows which ones work, how to fix the ones that don't, and measures the performance of each. Recommended settings can be applied to Jellyfin's settings and reverted, or downloaded as a diagnostics zip to attach to an issue.
overview: Tests which hardware transcoding backends work on a Jellyfin server, and how fast each one transcodes
